# Generator for internal/govadmin/testdata/permissions.json (run from legacy/python).
import json, sys
from apps.api.routers.governance import PERMISSIONS
out = [{"key": k, "label": v[0], "description": v[1], "default_roles": v[2]} for k, v in PERMISSIONS.items()]
json.dump(out, sys.stdout, indent=2); print()
